items.name: Lily Pad Frog
items.details: PDF pattern · US terms · 4ply cotton · 2.25 mm hook
items.description: Crochet your own Lily Pad: a plump little pond frog in a lily pad hat with a coral lotus on top. An 8-page PDF with photos, round-by-round stitch counts and a diagram showing where the arms and feet go. The hat can sit wherever you like.
